disk_policy.why: no governed artifact declares a source/output size or execution write volume, so no defensible number could be derived; a baked-in default would be invention and would silently manufacture a pass
disk_policy.sampling: three samples, and the capacity verdict is taken against the WORST sample so a transient dip cannot produce a false pass

residual_gaps_acknowledged: The preflight verifies identity and capacity. It does NOT verify locators, warrants, adjudication or terrain; those remain their own gates and are untouched by this commission.

It checks the interpreter binary digest only. It does not attest the R7 venv's package closure, which the governing review separately recorded as self-declared non-durable and not reproducible from the repository. That finding belongs to R7 and is not reopened here.
It reads /System/Volumes/Data by default; if a future live run targets a different volume the target must be passed explicitly, and a wrong volume would be measured rather than assumed.
